# Talkera Desk

> Managed AI receptionist and phone answering for home service and restoration businesses.

## What Talkera Desk is

Talkera Desk is a managed AI receptionist service operated by DRUVA GROUP, an India-based sole proprietorship owned by Ayush Raj. It answers inbound business calls, gathers job details, books appointments in connected calendars or job software, and sends text updates to callers and the business team. Setup takes up to 3 days.

Talkera Desk is a phone service, not a physical desk, furniture, or printed table display.

## Who it serves

Home service and restoration businesses, including plumbing, HVAC, electrical, and water or fire damage restoration. The team works from Kolkata, India. The service is offered to businesses in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and India.

## What it does

- Answers inbound calls 24/7 and gathers the caller's issue, address, and urgency.
- Books appointments in connected calendars or supported job software and CRMs.
- Sends visit confirmations and job details to callers and team members by text.
- Is configured and tested for each business before launch.

Call capacity depends on the selected plan. If all call lines are in use or there is a phone service outage, a call may not be answered.

## Plans and prices

Prices are in USD. Pay As You Go costs $0.59 per minute with a $95 monthly minimum and supports 2 calls at once. Growth costs $383 per month for 743 minutes and 3 calls at once. Pro costs $581 per month for 1,292 minutes and 5 calls at once. Expansion costs $950 per month for 1,994 minutes and 8 calls at once. Custom plans are available for 5,000 or more minutes and 8 or more calls at once. The website lists no setup fee or long-term contract.

## Operator and contact

Talkera Desk is a brand of DRUVA GROUP, a sole proprietorship owned by Ayush Raj and registered in India. The operating team is based in Kolkata, India. Contact: support@talkeradesk.com. Registration and legal details are on the Legal page.
